name: Latvia University of Life Sciences and Technologies
summary: Jelgava university of life sciences and technologies with three English-taught bachelor's and a six-year Veterinary Medicine degree in English.

ib.text: No IB-specific page: a secondary diploma that makes you eligible for university at home, an average of at least 65%, English B2 (or a test) and an online entrance test in the programme's subject.

lastYear.text: autumn: no visa needed 15 Jul (visa 15 Jun)

programmes.name: Biosystems Machinery and Technologies
programmes.about: Engineering design, mechatronics and programming joined with the basics of biosystems in agriculture, wood processing, food production and animal husbandry, including CNC manufacturing technology.
programmes.ib: A satisfactory grade in Maths, English at B2 or IELTS 6.0, and an online entrance test in Maths; average of at least 65% on your previous qualification.

needs.note: At least a 'satisfactory' grade; LBTU gives no IB conversion

programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths entrance test, then an interview; the group runs only if at least five students enrol. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Information Technologies for Sustainable Development
programmes.about: Software design with attention to the sustainability of software and hardware, in laboratories for development and quality assurance, with a year of internship at IT companies; qualification Programming Engineer.
programmes.ib: A satisfactory grade in Maths, English at B2 or IELTS 6.0, and an online entrance test in computer science; average of at least 65% on your previous qualification.

needs.note: At least a 'satisfactory' grade; LBTU gives no IB conversion

programmes.selectionNote: Online computer-science entrance test, then an interview; the group runs only if at least five students enrol. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Sociology of Organizations and Public Administration
programmes.about: Contemporary society and its organisations studied with e-learning, guest-lecture weeks, field trips and discussions, in a student-centred programme with September and February entry.
programmes.ib: English at B2 or IELTS 6.0 and an online aptitude test in social sciences; average of at least 65% on your previous qualification.
programmes.selectionNote: Online social-sciences aptitude test, then an interview; the group runs only if at least five students enrol. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year English-taught programme (360 ECTS) on animal health, disease diagnosis and treatment, zoonoses and food hygiene, following a One Medicine - One Health concept; the qualification is Veterinarian.
programmes.ib: A satisfactory grade in Biology or Chemistry, English at B2 or IELTS 6.0, and an online entrance test in biology and chemistry.

needs.note: At least a 'satisfactory' grade; LBTU gives no IB conversion

programmes.selectionNote: Online biology and chemistry entrance test, then an interview. European veterinary accreditation runs to November 2026 with a visit in September 2026.

notes: The application fee is 160 euro for EU/EEA/Swiss citizens (230 for most other nationalities), and a 500 euro study deposit is returned after graduation.
A study group runs only if at least five students enrol, and Sociology of Organizations and Public Administration also admits in February.
Tuition is the same for EU and non-EU applicants on these pages; no separate EU rate or state-funded place is listed.
